# Aptor Studies

> Aptor Studies is a premier education consultancy and portal with over 25 years of experience, connecting exceptional students with prestigious higher education institutions in India (Bengaluru, Kerala) and abroad.

## Core Offerings & Services
- [Colleges](https://aptorstudies.com/colleges): Explore top engineering, medical, arts, science, commerce, and law colleges in Bengaluru and Kerala.
- [Courses](https://aptorstudies.com/courses): Comprehensive database of undergraduate and postgraduate courses, eligibility criteria, fee structures, and entrance exams.
- [Academy](https://aptorstudies.com/academy): Skill development programs, vocational training, and competitive exam preparation.
- [Counselling](https://aptorstudies.com/counselling): 1-on-1 expert career counselling, university selection, admission application assistance, and visa guidance.
- [Scholarships](https://aptorstudies.com/scholarships): Discover merit-based, financial-aid, and institutional scholarship opportunities.
- [Accommodation](https://aptorstudies.com/accommodation): Safe, verified, and convenient student housing and hostel options near major colleges.
- [Blogs](https://aptorstudies.com/blogs): Educational news, admission guides, entrance exam updates, and career roadmaps.
